goal.objective: Prove the provider-agnostic process adapter can execute a real bounded repository mutation over two transitions on the single StegVerse heartbeat without granting general mutation authority.
success_predicates: Heartbeat atomically checks out exactly one canary worker
Worker returns ACTIVE on first heartbeat and COMPLETED on the next heartbeat
Claim and fencing token remain stable across both transitions
Completion releases the worker and retains inspectable evidence
failure_predicates: Worker mutates outside the admitted receipt namespace
Worker runs without a fenced claim
A third-party scheduler is treated as execution authority

task.derivation_reason: Real bounded executor proof required before any broader mutation-capable worker binding.

completion.next_authorized_action: None for this canary. Use its executor and custody evidence to close SHWP executor proof and advance broader lifecycle-custody coverage without granting general mutation authority.
